---
title: "1.Padj_manual"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-16"
---

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Update paths and sample names in the USER SETTINGS section as needed.
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)
library(DESeq2)
library(genefilter)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# Base paths
path <- "data/"
raw_data <- "Raw_Data/"
results <- "Results/"

path_raw_data <- file.path(path, raw_data)
path_results  <- file.path(path, results)

if (!dir.exists(path_results)) dir.create(path_results, recursive = TRUE)

# 1. Automatically detect the DESeq2 RDS file

dds_file <- list.files(
  path_raw_data,
  pattern = "dds\\.rld\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(dds_file) != 1) {
  stop("Expected exactly one .dds.rld.rds file in Raw_Data/. Found: ", length(dds_file))
}

message("Using DESeq2 object: ", basename(dds_file))

dds <- readRDS(dds_file)


# 2. Automatically detect the contrast CSV file

contrast_file <- list.files(
  path_raw_data,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(contrast_file) != 1) {
  stop("Expected exactly one contrast CSV file in Raw_Data/. Found: ", length(contrast_file))
}

message("Using contrast file: ", basename(contrast_file))

contrasts <- read.csv(contrast_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Remove blocking column if present
if ("blocking" %in% colnames(contrasts)) {
  contrasts$blocking <- NULL
}

# Loop over contrasts
for (i in seq_len(nrow(contrasts))) {
  
  contrast_name <- contrasts$id[i]          # name for output files
  variable      <- contrasts$variable[i]    # e.g. "condition"
  reference     <- contrasts$reference[i]   # baseline
  target        <- contrasts$target[i]      # comparison
  
  message("Processing: ", contrast_name,
          "  (", variable, ": ", target, " vs ", reference, ")")
  
  # DESeq2 contrast vector: log2FC = target / reference
  contrast_vec <- c(variable, target, reference)
  
  # Extract results
  res <- results(dds, contrast = contrast_vec)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  
  res_df$gene_symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = rownames(res_df),
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

res_df$gene_symbol[is.na(res_df$gene_symbol)] <- rownames(res_df)[is.na(res_df$gene_symbol)]
  
  # Manual padj
  res_df$padj_manual <- p.adjust(res_df$pvalue, method = "BH")
  res_df$padj_manual_noNA <- ifelse(is.na(res_df$padj_manual), 1, res_df$padj_manual)
  res_df <- res_df[, c("gene_symbol", setdiff(colnames(res_df), "gene_symbol"))]
  
  # Output filename
  out_file <- file.path(path_results, paste0(contrast_name, "_manual_padj.rds"))
  
  saveRDS(res_df, out_file)
}
```
